literal: Food, clothing, other things, to living beings all, different are not; modesty possession human beings' distinction.
translation: Food, clothing, and other such things are not different for all living beings. The possession of modesty is the special distinction of human beings.
modern: உணவு, உடை மற்றும் பிற தேவைகள் எல்லா உயிர்களுக்கும் பொதுவானவை. ஆனால் நாணம் என்னும் பண்பைக் கொண்டிருப்பதே மனிதர்களுக்கு உரிய சிறப்பம்சமாகும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the basic physical needs of life with the moral quality of modesty. The words 'ஊண்' (food), 'உடை' (clothing), and 'எச்சம்' (the rest) represent necessities that all living beings share, making them common to all. The true distinction ('சிறப்பு') of human beings ('மாந்தர்') lies in 'நாணுடைமை', the possession of a sense of shame or moral modesty. It is this inner quality that elevates humans above other creatures.
